prior_summary: World-aligned Cartesian targets translated to the causal blue_goal make final approach, lowering, release and retreat move exactly with the calibrated drawer destination.
applicable_conditions: Prefer with drawer_position > 0.26 m after closed-finger blue/TCP co-motion suggests the blue block is being carried and changed drawer-goal alignment is the main risk. It still covers the whole release-to-pick overlap. destination_field must be blue_goal.
termination_guidance: Use only the unchanged simultaneous drawer-open, red-on-pad and blue-inside evaluator expression. Release and high retreat remain demonstrated context rather than new requirements.
limitations: A point goal omits wall/lip geometry and route planning; translated goals can be unreachable; world orientation is not invariant to drawer rotation; source pickup displacement is conditioned but not invariant; no collision or recovery examples exist.
